# Logical B/C contract fixture

`items-actors-bc-synthetic.json` contains synthetic rows and projections generated
by RePoE commit `e41401224a085a676c84b8f14b144f20fe37c79a`, using its
`NativeItemsActorsTests` setup and native fact producer. It contains no acquired
game table rows. The decoder repository URLs were added to the test source entry
to satisfy the Rust boundary's explicit tool identity contract.

Rust tests reconstruct simple column metadata from the stored field inventory;
its width of one (zero actual width for an empty table) is logical test metadata,
not a physical layout claim. The input manifest is resealed over these synthetic
documents. Source projections remain producer-generated, not generated by the
Rust normalizer under test. Numeric IDs, duplicate/null relations, empty actor
tables and negative-zero values are intentional contract cases.

The separate `items-actors-bc-manifest.json` is metadata from the real reviewed
77-table candidate; it contains no physical game payloads. Actual byte-pinned
acceptance and synthetic contract tests have distinct source/provenance roles.
